products.title: Dell Pro Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock SD25TB4
products.description: Maximize your workspace efficiency with the Dell SD25TB4 Pro Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock station. This dock is designed for professionals who demand high performance with ultra-fast connectivity, security, and flexibility. Built with 65% recycled materials and eco-conscious packaging, this dock is an all-in-one workstation solution for power users, professionals, and IT teams who need security, performance, and flexibility in a single device. Bundle includes the Dell SD25TB4 Pro Thunderbolt 4 Smart Dock, two DisplayPort to DisplayPort cables, two USB-A to USB-C cables, two USB-C to USB-C cables, one Ethernet patch cable, adjustable cord straps, one HDMI cable, a cleaning kit, a USB Type C to HDMI 3.1 cable, and the MK540 Advanced Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo.
